title: Monthly Growth of the HECM Available Line
content:
On plans whose unused available line grows, the available line of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) grows every month at an annual rate equal to the note rate in effect for the month plus the plan's line growth spread, compounded monthly.

- **Credit.** Growth for a month is credited on the plan's assessment day of the following month and belongs to that month. It is figured on the available line at the end of the month, multiplied by one twelfth of the annual growth rate, rounded half up to the cent; the credit records the annual growth rate used.
- **Status.** Line growth is credited only while the loan status is active; growth stops for good once the loan is due and payable, in the deferral period or terminated.
- **No credit.** A month whose ending available line is 0.00 posts no credit, and the fixed-rate single disbursement plan never earns growth.
- **Once.** Each growth month is credited once.

*Worked example (hypothetical inputs):* a month-end available line of 90000.00, a note rate of 5.500 percent and a spread of 0.50 percentage points give an annual growth rate of 6.000 percent and a credit of 90000.00 multiplied by one twelfth of 6.000 percent, that is 450.00, credited on the assessment day of the next month.

| Loan status | Ending available line | Growth credited |
|---|---|---|
| active | above 0.00 | yes, on a growing plan |
| active | 0.00 | no |
| due and payable, deferral period or terminated | any | no |
